### ✨ New Features

patches.name: Proxy
patches.description: Routes all of the app's traffic through your HTTP or HTTPS proxy, with optional username and password. Nothing goes direct, even if the proxy is down.

options.description: Hostname or IP address of the proxy, for example proxy.example.com.
Port of the proxy, for example 443 for an HTTPS proxy or 8080 for a plain HTTP proxy.
On: the connection to the proxy itself is encrypted (an "HTTPS proxy", such as Caddy forward_proxy). Off: a plain HTTP proxy.
Proxy username. Leave empty if the proxy has no login. Stored in plain text inside the patched app, so don't share the patched APK.
Proxy password. Leave empty if the proxy has no login.
